sanskrit: parivādo dvijātīnāṃ na śrotavyaḥ kathaṃ cana āsītādhomukhas tūṣṇīṃ samutthāya vrajeta vā
english: Reviling of the twice-born must never be listened to under any circumstance. Either let a man sit silent with face bowed down, or let him rise and walk away.

sanskrit: na sa jāto janiṣyo vā pṛthivyām iha kaś cana yo brāhmaṇavirodhena sukhaṃ jīvitum utsahet
english: There is none born, nor to be born, upon this earth, who by setting himself against the brāhmaṇas could dare to live in ease.

sanskrit: durgraho muṣṭinā vāyur duḥsparśaḥ pāṇinā śaśī durdharā pṛthivī mūrdhnā durjayā brāhmaṇā bhuvi
english: Hard to seize with the fist is the wind, hard to touch with the hand is the moon, hard to bear upon the head is the earth—and hard to conquer upon this world are the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca brāhmaṇān eva satataṃ bhṛśaṃ saṃpratipūjayet ete hi somarājāna īśvarāḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ
english: Bhīṣma said: The brāhmaṇas, ever and always, one should honor with the utmost zeal, for they have Soma for their king and are the masters of joy and sorrow.

sanskrit: ete bhogair alaṃkārair anyaiś caiva kim icchakaiḥ sadā pūjyā namaskāryā rakṣyāś ca pitṛvan nṛpaiḥ ato rāṣṭrasya śāntir hi bhūtānām iva vāsavāt
english: With enjoyments, with adornments, and with whatever else they may desire, they are ever to be honored, saluted, and protected by kings as one's own fathers; for from this comes the peace of the realm, as the peace of all beings comes from Vāsava.

sanskrit: jāyatāṃ brahmavarcasvī rāṣṭre vai brāhmaṇaḥ śuciḥ mahārathaś ca rājanya eṣṭavyaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ
english: Let there be born in the realm a pure brāhmaṇa radiant with sacred lore; and a mighty-chariot warrior of the royal line, a scorcher of foes, is to be wished for.

sanskrit: brāhmaṇaṃ jātisaṃpannaṃ dharmajñaṃ saṃśitavratam vāsayeta gṛhe rājan na tasmāt param asti vai
english: A brāhmaṇa endowed with noble birth, knowing dharma, of well-honed vows—him, O king, let one settle in one's house; truly there is nothing higher than that.

sanskrit: brāhmaṇebhyo havir dattaṃ pratigṛhṇanti devatāḥ pitaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ naitebhyo vidyate param
english: The oblation given to brāhmaṇas the gods receive, and the fathers of all beings; than these there is known nothing higher.

sanskrit: ādityaś candramā vāyur bhūmir āpo 'mbaraṃ diśaḥ sarve brāhmaṇam āviśya sadānnam upabhuñjate
english: The sun, the moon, the wind, the earth, the waters, the sky, the quarters—all of these, entering into the brāhmaṇa, partake of the good food offered.

sanskrit: na tasyāśnanti pitaro yasya viprā na bhuñjate devāś cāpy asya nāśnanti pāpasya brāhmaṇadviṣaḥ
english: The fathers do not eat of the man whose brāhmaṇas do not eat; nor do the gods partake of that sinner who hates the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit: brāhmaṇeṣu tu tuṣṭeṣu prīyante pitaraḥ sadā tathaiva devatā rājan nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
english: But when the brāhmaṇas are content, the fathers too are ever pleased, and likewise the gods, O king; in this no doubt need be entertained.

sanskrit: tathaiva te 'pi prīyante yeṣāṃ bhavati tad dhaviḥ na ca pretya vinaśyanti gacchanti paramāṃ gatim
english: Likewise are those pleased to whom that oblation comes; and they do not perish after death, but attain the supreme goal.

sanskrit: yena yenaiva haviṣā brāhmaṇāṃs tarpayen naraḥ tena tenaiva prīyante pitaro devatās tathā
english: By whatever oblation a man satisfies the brāhmaṇas, by that very same the fathers are pleased, and the gods as well.

sanskrit: brāhmaṇād eva tad bhūtaṃ prabhavanti yataḥ prajāḥ yataś cāyaṃ prabhavati pretya yatra ca gacchati
english: From the brāhmaṇa alone arises that being whence creatures spring, whence this world comes forth, and whither it goes after death.

sanskrit: vedaiṣa mārgaṃ svargasya tathaiva narakasya ca āgatānāgate cobhe brāhmaṇo dvipadāṃ varaḥ brāhmaṇo bharataśreṣṭha svadharmaṃ veda medhayā
english: He knows the path of heaven and likewise of hell, both what has come and what has not yet come—the brāhmaṇa, best of two-footed beings. The brāhmaṇa, O finest of the Bhāratas, knows his own dharma by his wisdom.

sanskrit: ye cainam anuvartante te na yānti parābhavam na te pretya vinaśyanti gacchanti na parābhavam
english: And those who follow him go not to ruin; they do not perish after death, nor do they come to downfall.

sanskrit: ye brāhmaṇamukhāt prāptaṃ pratigṛhṇanti vai vacaḥ kṛtātmāno mahātmānas te na yānti parābhavam
english: Those who accept the word received from the brāhmaṇa's mouth—the perfected of soul, the great-spirited—they go not to downfall.

sanskrit: kṣatriyāṇāṃ pratapatāṃ tejasā ca balena ca brāhmaṇeṣv eva śāmyanti tejāṃsi ca balāni ca
english: Of the kṣatriyas who blaze forth with energy and with might, their splendors and their powers find their quenching in the brāhmaṇas alone.

sanskrit: bhṛgavo 'jayaṃs tālajaṅghān nīpān aṅgiraso 'jayan bharadvājo vaitahavyān ailāṃś ca bharatarṣabha
english: The Bhṛgus conquered the Tālajaṅghas, the Aṅgirases conquered the Nīpas, and Bharadvāja conquered the Vaitahavyas and the Ailas, O bull of the Bhāratas.

sanskrit: citrāyudhāṃś cāpy ajayann ete kṛṣṇājinadhvajāḥ prakṣipyātha ca kumbhān vai pāragāminam ārabhet
english: These, with the black antelope-skin for their banner, conquered even the Citrāyudhas; and having cast away the water-jars, one should set out upon him who would carry men across.

sanskrit: yat kiṃ cit kathyate loke śrūyate paśyate 'pi vā sarvaṃ tad brāhmaṇeṣv eva gūḍho 'gnir iva dāruṣu
english: Whatever is told in the world, whatever is heard or seen, all of that abides in the brāhmaṇas, as fire lies hidden in wood.

sanskrit: atrāpy udāharantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanam saṃvādaṃ vāsudevasya pṛthvyāś ca bharatarṣabha
english: On this point, too, they recite this ancient tale, the dialogue between Vāsudeva and the Earth, O bull of the Bhāratas.

sanskrit: vāsudeva uvāca mātaraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ pṛcche tvā saṃśayaṃ śubhe kena svit karmaṇā pāpaṃ vyapohati naro gṛhī
english: Vāsudeva said: O auspicious one, mother of all beings, I ask you my doubt: by what deed does a householder put away his sin?

sanskrit: pṛthivy uvāca brāhmaṇān eva seveta pavitraṃ hy etad uttamam brāhmaṇān sevamānasya rajaḥ sarvaṃ praṇaśyati
english: The Earth said: Let him serve the brāhmaṇas, for this is the highest purifier; for one who serves the brāhmaṇas, all his impurity is destroyed.

sanskrit: ato bhūtir ataḥ kīrtir ato buddhiḥ prajāyate apareṣāṃ pareṣāṃ ca parebhyaś caiva ye pare
english: From this comes prosperity, from this glory, from this is wisdom born—for those below, for those above, and for those still beyond the highest.

sanskrit: brāhmaṇā yaṃ praśaṃsanti puruṣaḥ sa pravardhate atha yo brāhmaṇākruṣṭaḥ parābhavati so 'cirāt
english: The man whom the brāhmaṇas praise, he flourishes; but he who is reviled by the brāhmaṇas comes to ruin before long.

sanskrit: yathā mahārṇave kṣipta āmaloṣṭo vinaśyati tathā duścaritaṃ karma parābhāvāya kalpate
english: As a lump of unbaked clay cast into the great ocean dissolves away, so an ill-doing deed conduces to one's downfall.

sanskrit: paśya candre kṛtaṃ lakṣma samudre lavaṇodakam tathā bhagasahasreṇa mahendraṃ paricihnitam
english: Behold the mark set upon the moon, the salt water in the ocean, and great Indra branded with the thousand marks.

sanskrit: teṣām eva prabhāvena sahasranayano hy asau śatakratuḥ samabhavat paśya mādhava yādṛśam
english: By their very power he became the thousand-eyed one, the lord of a hundred sacrifices—behold, O Mādhava, of what kind that was.

sanskrit: icchan bhūtiṃ ca kīrtiṃ ca lokāṃś ca madhusūdana brāhmaṇānumate tiṣṭhet puruṣaḥ śucir ātmavān
english: Desiring prosperity and glory and the higher worlds, O slayer of Madhu, let a man abide pure and self-possessed by the consent of the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit: ity etad vacanaṃ śrutvā medinyā madhusūdanaḥ sādhu sādhv ity athety uktvā medinīṃ pratyapūjayat
english: Having heard this word of the Earth, the slayer of Madhu, saying "Well said, well said, so be it," did reverence to the Earth in return.

sanskrit: etāṃ śrutvopamāṃ pārtha prayato brāhmaṇarṣabhān satataṃ pūjayethās tvaṃ tataḥ śreyo 'bhipatsyase
english: Having heard this parable, O Pārtha, with diligence honor the bulls among brāhmaṇas continually; thereby you shall attain to good.

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca janmanaiva mahābhāgo brāhmaṇo nāma jāyate namasyaḥ sarvabhūtānām atithiḥ prasṛtāgrabhuk
english: Bhīṣma said: By his very birth the one called brāhmaṇa is born greatly blessed, to be saluted by all beings, a guest who eats the first portion set forth.

sanskrit: sarvān naḥ suhṛdas tāta brāhmaṇāḥ sumanomukhāḥ gīrbhir maṅgalayuktābhir anudhyāyanti pūjitāḥ
english: All the brāhmaṇas are our well-wishers, my son, kindly of face; when honored, they wish us well with words laden with blessing.

sanskrit: sarvān no dviṣatas tāta brāhmaṇā jātamanyavaḥ gīrbhir dāruṇayuktābhir abhihanyur apūjitāḥ
english: But all the brāhmaṇas become our foes, my son, their wrath aroused, and when slighted they would strike with words laden with menace.

sanskrit: atra gāthā brahmagītāḥ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ sṛṣṭvā dvijātīn dhātā hi yathāpūrvaṃ samādadhat
english: On this point those who know the past recite verses sung by Brahmā; for the Ordainer, having created the twice-born, addressed them as of old.

sanskrit: na vo 'nyad iha kartavyaṃ kiṃ cid ūrdhvaṃ yathāvidhi guptā gopāyata brahma śreyo vas tena śobhanam
english: Nothing else here, nothing beyond, need be done by you according to rule: guarded yourselves, guard the sacred lore—therein lies your fair and excellent good.

sanskrit: svam eva kurvatāṃ karma śrīr vo brāhmī bhaviṣyati pramāṇaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ pragrahaṃ ca gamiṣyatha
english: As you perform your own proper work, the splendor of Brahman shall be yours; you shall become the measure of all beings, and shall attain to mastery over them.

sanskrit: na śaudraṃ karma kartavyaṃ brāhmaṇena vipaścitā śaudraṃ hi kurvataḥ karma dharmaḥ samuparudhyate
english: No śūdra's work should be done by a learned brāhmaṇa, for when one performs a śūdra's work, his dharma is obstructed.

sanskrit: śrīś ca buddhiś ca tejaś ca vibhūtiś ca pratāpinī svādhyāyenaiva māhātmyaṃ vimalaṃ pratipatsyatha
english: Splendor and wisdom and energy and majestic dominion—and through self-study alone you shall attain a stainless greatness of soul.

sanskrit: hutvā cāhavanīyasthaṃ mahābhāgye pratiṣṭhitāḥ agrabhojyāḥ prasūtīnāṃ śriyā brāhmyānukalpitāḥ
english: Having offered into the fire set in the āhavanīya hearth, established in high blessedness, you are the first to be fed among created beings, fashioned with the splendor of Brahman.

sanskrit: śraddhayā parayā yuktā hy anabhidrohalabdhayā damasvādhyāyaniratāḥ sarvān kāmān avāpsyatha
english: Endowed with supreme faith, gained without malice, devoted to self-restraint and self-study, you shall attain all your desires.

sanskrit: yac caiva mānuṣe loke yac ca deveṣu kiṃ cana sarvaṃ tat tapasā sādhyaṃ jñānena vinayena ca
english: Whatever there is in the world of men, and whatever among the gods, all of that is attainable by austerity, by knowledge, and by discipline.

sanskrit: ity etā brahmagītās te samākhyātā mayānagha viprānukampārtham idaṃ tena proktaṃ hi dhīmatā
english: Thus have these verses sung by Brahmā been recounted to you by me, O sinless one; for this was uttered by that wise one out of compassion for the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit: bhūyas teṣāṃ balaṃ manye yathā rājñas tapasvinaḥ durāsadāś ca caṇḍāś ca rabhasāḥ kṣiprakāriṇaḥ
english: Greater still I deem the power of those ascetics than even that of a king: unapproachable, fierce, impetuous, swift to act.

sanskrit: santy eṣāṃ siṃhasattvāś ca vyāghrasattvās tathāpare varāhamṛgasattvāś ca gajasattvās tathāpare
english: Among them are some of lion-nature and others of tiger-nature, some of boar-and-deer nature and others of elephant-nature.

sanskrit: karpāsamṛdavaḥ ke cit tathānye makaraspṛśaḥ vibhāṣyaghātinaḥ ke cit tathā cakṣurhaṇo 'pare
english: Some are soft as cotton, while others strike like the makara; some slay by mere speech, and others slay with a glance.

sanskrit: santi cāśīviṣanibhāḥ santi mandās tathāpare vividhānīha vṛttāni brāhmaṇānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira
english: There are those like venomous serpents, and there are others mild; manifold are the ways of the brāhmaṇas here, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit: mekalā dramiḍāḥ kāśāḥ pauṇḍrāḥ kollagirās tathā śauṇḍikā daradā darvāś caurāḥ śabarabarbarāḥ
english: The Mekalas, the Dramiḍas, the Kāśas, the Pauṇḍras, and the Kollagiras, the Śauṇḍikas, the Daradas, the Darvas, the Cauras, the Śabaras and Barbaras—

sanskrit: kirātā yavanāś caiva tās tāḥ kṣatriyajātayaḥ vṛṣalatvam anuprāptā brāhmaṇānām adarśanāt
english: the Kirātas and the Yavanas too—those various kṣatriya races sank into the state of low-born men through failing to behold the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit: brāhmaṇānāṃ paribhavād asurāḥ salileśayāḥ brāhmaṇānāṃ prasādāc ca devāḥ svarganivāsinaḥ
english: Through their contempt for the brāhmaṇas, the asuras lie sunk in the waters; and through the grace of the brāhmaṇas, the gods are dwellers in heaven.

sanskrit: aśakyaṃ spraṣṭum ākāśam acālyo himavān giriḥ avāryā setunā gaṅgā durjayā brāhmaṇā bhuvi
english: The sky cannot be touched, the Himavān mountain cannot be moved, the Gaṅgā cannot be dammed by any dike—and the brāhmaṇas cannot be conquered upon this earth.

sanskrit: na brāhmaṇavirodhena śakyā śāstuṃ vasuṃdharā brāhmaṇā hi mahātmāno devānām api devatāḥ
english: By setting oneself against the brāhmaṇas, the earth cannot be ruled; for the brāhmaṇas, the great-souled, are deities even of the gods.

sanskrit: tān pūjayasva satataṃ dānena paricaryayā yadīcchasi mahīṃ bhoktum imāṃ sāgaramekhalām
english: Honor them continually with gifts and with service, if you wish to enjoy this earth that is girdled by the sea.

sanskrit: pratigraheṇa tejo hi viprāṇāṃ śāmyate 'nagha pratigrahaṃ ye neccheyus te 'pi rakṣyās tvayānagha
english: By the receiving of gifts the energy of the brāhmaṇas is quieted, O sinless one; and those who would not wish to receive gifts—they too are to be protected by you, O sinless one.

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca atrāpy udāharantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanam śakraśambarasaṃvādaṃ tan nibodha yudhiṣṭhira
english: Bhīṣma said: On this point, too, they recite this ancient tale, the dialogue between Śakra and Śambara; mark it well, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit: śakro hy ajñātarūpeṇa jaṭī bhūtvā rajoruṇaḥ virūpaṃ rūpam āsthāya praśnaṃ papraccha śambaram
english: Śakra, in a form unrecognized, having become a matted-haired ascetic ruddy with dust, and taking on an ugly shape, put a question to Śambara.

sanskrit: kena śambara vṛttena svajātyān adhitiṣṭhasi śreṣṭhaṃ tvāṃ kena manyante tan me prabrūhi pṛcchataḥ
english: By what conduct, O Śambara, do you stand above those of your own race? For what reason do they hold you to be the best? Tell me that, who ask you.

sanskrit: śambara uvāca nāsūyāmi sadā viprān brahmāṇaṃ ca pitāmaham śāstrāṇi vadato viprān saṃmanyāmi yathāsukham
english: Śambara said: I never spurn the brāhmaṇas, nor Brahmā the grandfather; the brāhmaṇas, as they expound the sacred texts, I honor to their full content.

sanskrit: śrutvā ca nāvajānāmi nāparādhyāmi karhi cit abhyarcyān anupṛcchāmi pādau gṛhṇāmi dhīmatām
english: And having heard them, I do not despise them, nor do I ever offend; the worshipful I question with deference, and I clasp the feet of the wise.

sanskrit: te viśrabdhāḥ prabhāṣante saṃyacchanti ca māṃ sadā pramatteṣv apramatto 'smi sadā supteṣu jāgṛmi
english: Trustful, they speak freely and ever restrain me from error; among the heedless I am heedful, and among the sleeping I keep ever awake.

sanskrit: te mā śāstrapathe yuktaṃ brahmaṇyam anasūyakam samāsiñcanti śāstāraḥ kṣaudraṃ madhv iva makṣikāḥ
english: Those teachers pour upon me—set on the path of the scriptures, devoted to the brāhmaṇas, free of envy—their instruction, as bees pour out their honey.

sanskrit: yac ca bhāṣanti te tuṣṭās tat tad gṛhṇāmi medhayā samādhim ātmano nityam anulomam acintayan
english: And whatever they, well-pleased, declare, that I receive with my understanding, ever keeping the composure of my soul attuned and undisturbed in thought.

sanskrit: so 'haṃ vāgagrasṛṣṭānāṃ rasānām avalehakaḥ svajātyān adhitiṣṭhāmi nakṣatrāṇīva candramāḥ
english: Thus I, the licker of the savors poured forth from the tip of their speech, stand above those of my own race, as the moon above the constellations.

sanskrit: etat pṛthivyām amṛtam etac cakṣur anuttamam yad brāhmaṇamukhāc chāstram iha śrutvā pravartate
english: This is the nectar upon the earth, this the unsurpassed eye—the teaching which, heard here from the brāhmaṇa's mouth, sets one upon his way.

sanskrit: etat kāraṇam ājñāya dṛṣṭvā devāsuraṃ purā yuddhaṃ pitā me hṛṣṭātmā vismitaḥ pratyapadyata
english: Having learned this cause, and having beheld of old the war between the gods and the asuras, my father, glad of heart and amazed, came to acknowledge it.

sanskrit: dṛṣṭvā ca brāhmaṇānāṃ tu mahimānaṃ mahātmanām paryapṛcchat katham ime siddhā iti niśākaram
english: And having beheld the greatness of the great-souled brāhmaṇas, he asked the moon, the night-maker, "How is it that these have attained perfection?"

sanskrit: soma uvāca brāhmaṇās tapasā sarve sidhyante vāgbalāḥ sadā bhujavīryā hi rājāno vāgastrāś ca dvijātayaḥ
english: Soma said: The brāhmaṇas all attain perfection through austerity, their strength ever in their speech; for kings have their valor in their arms, but the twice-born have speech for their weapon.

sanskrit: pravasan vāpy adhīyīta bahvīr durvasatīr vasan nirmanyur api nirmāno yatiḥ syāt samadarśanaḥ
english: Even while abroad let him study, dwelling through many hard sojournings; free of wrath and free of pride, an ascetic let him be, looking on all alike.

sanskrit: api cej jātisaṃpannaḥ sarvān vedān pitur gṛhe ślāghamāna ivādhīyed grāmya ity eva taṃ viduḥ
english: Even if one of noble birth should study all the Vedas in his father's house, yet study as if boasting of it, him they call a vulgar man.

sanskrit: bhūmir etau nigirati sarpo bilaśayān iva rājānaṃ cāpy ayoddhāraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ cāpravāsinam
english: The earth swallows up these two, as a serpent swallows creatures that lie in their holes: the king who will not fight, and the brāhmaṇa who will not go abroad.

sanskrit: atimānaḥ śriyaṃ hanti puruṣasyālpamedhasaḥ garbheṇa duṣyate kanyā gṛhavāsena ca dvijaḥ
english: Excessive pride destroys the fortune of a man of little understanding; a maiden is spoiled by an untimely conceiving, and a brāhmaṇa by mere staying at home.

sanskrit: ity etan me pitā śrutvā somād adbhutadarśanāt brāhmaṇān pūjayām āsa tathaivāhaṃ mahāvratān
english: Having heard this from Soma of wondrous aspect, my father honored the brāhmaṇas of great vows—and even so do I.

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca śrutvaitad vacanaṃ śakro dānavendramukhāc cyutam dvijān saṃpūjayām āsa mahendratvam avāpa ca
english: Bhīṣma said: Having heard this word fallen from the mouth of the lord of the dānavas, Śakra honored the twice-born, and attained the sovereignty of great Indra.

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca apūrvaṃ vā bhavet pātram atha vāpi ciroṣitam dūrād abhyāgataṃ vāpi kiṃ pātraṃ syāt pitāmaha
english: Yudhiṣṭhira said: A worthy recipient may be one newly come, or one who has dwelt long with us, or one arrived from afar; who, O grandfather, is a fit recipient?

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca kriyā bhavati keṣāṃ cid upāṃśuvratam uttamam yo yo yāceta yat kiṃ cit sarvaṃ dadyāma ity uta
english: Bhīṣma said: For some, the rite is this—a vow kept in silence is the highest: "Whoever begs whatever it may be, all of it let us give."

sanskrit: apīḍayan bhṛtyavargam ity evam anuśuśruma pīḍayan bhṛtyavargaṃ hi ātmānam apakarṣati
english: Yet without oppressing one's dependants—thus have we heard it taught; for he who oppresses his dependants drags himself down.

sanskrit: apūrvaṃ vāpi yat pātraṃ yac cāpi syāc ciroṣitam dūrād abhyāgataṃ cāpi tat pātraṃ ca vidur budhāḥ
english: Whether the recipient be newly come, or one who has dwelt long, or one arrived from afar—the wise know him too to be a fit recipient.

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca apīḍayā ca bhṛtyānāṃ dharmasyāhiṃsayā tathā pātraṃ vidyāma tattvena yasmai dattaṃ na saṃtapet
english: Yudhiṣṭhira said: Without oppressing our dependants, and without harm to dharma, let us know in truth that recipient to whom a gift, once given, brings no regret.

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca ṛtvikpurohitācāryāḥ śiṣyāḥ saṃbandhibāndhavāḥ sarve pūjyāś ca mānyāś ca śrutavṛttopasaṃhitāḥ
english: Bhīṣma said: The officiating priest, the family priest, the teacher, disciples, kinsmen, and relations—all are to be honored and revered, provided they are endowed with sacred learning and good conduct.
